I added `src/exports/mergeExport.ts` with `exportMergedCsv(jobId, batchIds)`. I haven't compiled it or run it.

It loads all the batches in parallel with `loadBatch`. It joins the rows in the order of `batchIds`, then passes them through `toCsv` once. It uploads the result as `${jobId}.csv`, the same key `exportCsv` uses, and returns the upload URL. It also logs the row count, like `exportCsv` does.

Each row keeps its own `batch_id` column, so you can still tell which batch a row came from. An empty `batchIds` array uploads a CSV with only the header row.
